mapper.insert: INSERT INTO color_focus_score (user_id, best_score, best_accuracy, best_avg_reaction, best_switch_accuracy, max_streak, achieved_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bestScore}, #{bestAccuracy}, #{bestAvgReaction}, #{bestSwitchAccuracy}, #{maxStreak}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE color_focus_score SET best_score = GREATEST(best_score, #{dto.bestScore}), best_accuracy = CASE WHEN #{dto.bestAccuracy} IS NOT NULL AND (best_accuracy IS NULL OR #{dto.bestAccuracy} > best_accuracy) THEN #{dto.bestAccuracy} ELSE best_accuracy END, best_avg_reaction = CASE WHEN #{dto.bestAvgReaction} IS NOT NULL AND (best_avg_reaction IS NULL OR #{dto.bestAvgReaction} < best_avg_reaction) THEN #{dto.bestAvgReaction} ELSE best_avg_reaction END, best_switch_accuracy = CASE WHEN #{dto.bestSwitchAccuracy} IS NOT NULL AND (best_switch_accuracy IS NULL OR #{dto.bestSwitchAccuracy} > best_switch_accuracy) THEN #{dto.bestSwitchAccuracy} ELSE best_switch_accuracy END, max_streak = GREATEST(COALESCE(max_streak, 0), COALESCE(#{dto.maxStreak}, 0)), achieved_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.best_score AS bestScore, u.nickname AS nickname FROM color_focus_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_score DESC, s.achieved_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, s.best_score AS score, NULL AS secondaryScore FROM color_focus_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_score DESC, s.achieved_at ASC
